blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A “more comprehensive package” under the Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth) will be rolled out in late 2027 or early 2028 to support children who have been victims of violence, Health Secretary Edwin Mercado said on Wednesday. Mercado made this commitment during the sidelines of the 2nd Global Ministerial Conference on Ending Violence Against Children, in which the Philippines is hosting. Mercado noted that funding for coverage through PhilHealth will increase next year.
